A measuring cylinder of cross-sectional area 4.0cm2 contains 224cm3 of liquid.
The pressure of the liquid at the base of the measuring cylinder due to the liquid is 8800Pa.
What is the density of the liquid?

385kg/m3
1600kg/m3
2200kg/m3
